name: Annadata Sukhibhava – PM-KISAN
desc: State farmer assistance linked with PM-KISAN. Check beneficiary status at the dedicated government portal.
steps: Open the official beneficiary portal.
Ask the local Rythu Seva Kendra to confirm eligibility, records and any correction process.
Check the current instalment notification before expecting a payment.
contact: Rythu Seva Kendra / Mandal Agriculture Officer
docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: The 2 August 2025 PTI report describes ₹14,000 state support plus ₹6,000 PM-KISAN annually. Confirm current eligibility and instalments; do not add PM-KISAN a second time.

name: NTR Bharosa Pensions
desc: Monthly social-security pensions. The official portal lists enhanced rates under the June 2024 order, payable from July 2024.
steps: Confirm your pension category and current application window at the local secretariat.
Use the official portal for scheme information and contacts.
Ask the responsible welfare officer about missing records or payment issues.
docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: Listed rates: ₹4,000 for old age, widows and specified livelihood/social categories; ₹6,000 for disabled and multi-deformity leprosy categories; ₹10,000 for fully disabled and specified chronic-disease categories. Exact eligibility and medical classification require department confirmation.

name: Talliki Vandanam
desc: Education support for eligible mothers or guardians of school and Intermediate students. A total benefit and the amount reaching the bank account are different figures.
steps: Ask the school headteacher or junior college to confirm student records and the current rules.
Check the beneficiary information through the authorised local secretariat.
For missing or incorrect records, ask the school and secretariat for the official correction route.
contact: School headteacher / Junior College / Village or Ward Secretariat
docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: The official district page describes ₹15,000 assistance. July 2026 reporting says ₹13,000 reaches the mother/guardian and ₹2,000 is allocated to school upkeep. The current academic-year government order and individual payment status must be confirmed.

name: Deepam 2.0
desc: The official district Civil Supplies page describes three free LPG refills for eligible LPG consumers holding rice cards.
steps: Confirm rice-card and LPG-connection eligibility with the distributor or Civil Supplies office.
Ask the distributor about the current booking period and reimbursement process.
Keep the booking and payment receipt for any follow-up.
contact: LPG distributor / District Civil Supplies Officer
docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: Booking periods, upfront payment and reimbursement rules must be checked with the distributor. This app does not book cylinders.

name: Stree Shakti
benefit: Free travel on specified APSRTC services
desc: APSRTC lists free travel for AP-domiciled girls, women and transgender citizens with valid identification.
steps: Carry valid proof accepted by APSRTC.
Confirm that the bus category and route are covered before boarding.
Ask the conductor for the applicable zero-fare ticket.
docs: Valid identification accepted by APSRTC proving AP domicile.
amountNote: Covered: Pallevelugu, Ultra Pallevelugu, City Ordinary, Metro Express and Express. APSRTC excludes non-stop, interstate, chartered, contract-carriage services and package tours; enclave routes are permitted.

name: Aadabidda Nidhi
desc: A promise of monthly support for eligible women. An operative government order and current application process were not confirmed in this review.
steps: Watch for an official government order and eligibility guidelines.
Ask the local secretariat whether an authorised application process has opened.

sources.title: Background on the Super Six promises

docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: The reported promise covers ages 19–59. This is not a verified operative eligibility rule: an implementation order and rollout were not confirmed.

name: Yuva Nestham / Unemployment allowance
desc: An unemployment allowance was included in election promises. Current rollout, eligibility and an application window were not confirmed.
steps: Wait for an official notification.
Use authorised employment and skill-development services for current opportunities.
contact: District Employment Office / Skill Development Office

sources.title: Background on the Super Six promises

docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.

name: Divyang Shakti
benefit: Free / concessional travel by pass eligibility
desc: APSRTC provides a digital disability bus pass under Divyanga Shakthi, with benefits determined by the SADAREM record and bus category.
steps: Read the current APSRTC PwD pass FAQ.
Apply through the official APSRTC app or its listed government service.
Confirm the pass fee, eligible buses and escort rules before applying.
contact: APSRTC bus-pass counter / Official digital-pass support
docs: SADAREM ID and certificate; photo as requested by the official service.
amountNote: The FAQ lists a ₹100 digital-pass issuance fee. Free or concessional travel and escort eligibility depend on the pass details; this is a travel benefit, not a general cash grant.

name: Matsyakarula Sevalo
benefit: Fisheries support — current rules pending review
desc: Support for eligible fishing households. The supplied May 2026 announcement and its ₹286 crore figure have not been independently confirmed from an accessible official order.
steps: Ask the Fisheries Development Officer about the current fishing-ban relief notification.
Confirm the beneficiary survey, amount and correction process before submitting records.
contact: Fisheries Development Officer / District Fisheries Office

sources.title: User-provided May 2026 review report
sources.kind: User reference; page unavailable in review

docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.

name: Nethanna Sevalo
desc: August 2026 reporting describes support for eligible handloom-weaver households. The current official order, application window and any renamed-scheme relationship need confirmation.
steps: Ask the District Handlooms and Textiles Officer for the current order.
Confirm the weaver-register and household requirements.
Use only the application route specified by the department.
contact: District Handlooms and Textiles Officer / Local Secretariat
docs: Confirm the current document requirements with the department.
Provide personal documents only through the authorised application channel.
amountNote: ₹25,000 is a reported annual figure. Do not treat different historical scheme names as multiple independent benefits.

name: Dokka Seethamma Midday Meals
desc: Official district education pages describe midday meals in government and aided schools, with implementation also described for government junior colleges.
steps: Ask the headteacher or college principal whether the institution participates.
Confirm meal timings and the current menu at the institution.
contact: School headteacher / College principal / Mandal Education Officer
docs: Ask the institution about enrolment and participation requirements.

name: Anna Canteens
desc: The official P4 portal describes Anna Canteens as a community meal service. Confirm the nearest operating canteen, current price and serving times locally.
steps: Locate a nearby operating Anna Canteen.
Confirm the meal price and serving hours before travelling.
docs: Check the local canteen’s service conditions.
